tracking.reference_command: nominal policy command (before correction and fault)
tracking.z_map: solve(M[R,R], .) on the tracked dims, M = inv(M_inv); 0 elsewhere
tracking.observation: z_T = M_inv e_p (no division by n); after each step the reference leaks toward the measured pose by `leak`
tracking.observation_map: z_T[R] = solve(M[R,R], v[R]), z_T[not R] = 0, M = inv(M_inv), R = the tracked dims
